title: ML-AutoResearch: Training Machine Learning Research Agents with Automatically Generated Environments
abstract: arXiv:2603.17216v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the advent of AI agents, automated scientific discovery is becoming an increasingly plausible goal. However, training agents to autonomously execute the engineering-heavy labor of machine learning (ML) research requires massive, process-level supervision. Existing static benchmarks omit critical intermediate steps such as debugging and incremental reasoning, and manual data collection is prohibitively expensive. To overcome this data bottleneck, we introduce ML-AutoResearch (ML-AR), a scalable pipeline for automatically generating synthetic, end-to-end ML research tasks. Each task defines a complete research cycle, including problem specification, dataset selection, baseline implementation, and iterative improvement. To ensure realism and executability, tasks are grounded in real-world datasets and refined via an automated self-debugging procedure without requiring human supervision. translated_title: ML-AutoResearch：利用自动生成环境训练机器学习研究代理
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2603.17216v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：随着AI代理的出现，自动化科学发现正成为一个日益可行的目标。然而，训练代理自主执行机器学习（ML）研究中工程密集型劳动，需要大规模的过程级监督。现有的静态基准忽略了调试和增量推理等关键中间步骤，而手动数据收集成本过高。为克服这一数据瓶颈，我们引入了ML-AutoResearch（ML-AR），一种可扩展的流水线，用于自动生成合成的端到端机器学习研究任务。每个任务定义了一个完整的研究周期，包括问题规范、数据集选择、基线实现和迭代改进。为确保真实性和可执行性，任务基于真实世界数据集，并通过自动自我调试程序进行优化，无需人工监督。我们构建了一个大规模教师数据集。
tldr: 本文提出ML-AutoResearch，一种自动生成合成端到端机器学习研究任务的可扩展流水线，通过自我调试确保真实性，解决了训练研究代理所需数据瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ML-AutoResearch, a scalable pipeline for automatically generating synthetic end-to-end ML research tasks with self-debugging for realism, addressing the data bottleneck in training research agents.
